layout_recommendations.action: Retain reviewed component illustration as largest visual; align clear part code/title, existing intro and3–5 scope blocks. Use white space and left aligned hierarchy; no decorative photo generation.

Unify section start pages into a legible route map. Add brief before-reading prompt and maximum2 review questions only when they fit; dense13–30-section books keep section rows first, move additional prompts to cover small panel or master index without extra pages.

Add a restrained running header with part ID, current main section, current phase and main/reference status in existing safe top band; do not overlay original procedure content. Existing reference breadcrumbs/returns remain the authoritative route.
Use one main ink/navy hierarchy and reserved reference colors. Distinguish education navigation labels from source warnings; retain source warning labels and text exactly.

Treat mixed parts as a menu of independent operations. Avoid suggesting that all tailgate components, all general safety chapters or multiple electrical systems must be executed as one mechanical sequence.
